title: The Digital Security Landscape
tagline: Why cybersecurity exists, how attacks work, and where you fit in
description: Academy 1 starts here. No prior security knowledge required. This course answers the questions every security career begins with: what are we protecting, why does it matter, who are the attackers, and how do you start thinking like a defender? You will meet real breaches, real professionals, and the mental models that every security role depends on.
learningObjectives: Explain the real-world consequences of cybersecurity failures using the CIA triad
Describe what a Security Operations Centre analyst does on a typical day
Explain how cloud computing, mobile devices, and IoT expanded the global attack surface
Apply the security mindset — assume breach, find the weakest link, think about incentives — to everyday scenarios
Identify the major attack categories, threat actors, and the kill chain model
Name at least eight cybersecurity career roles and the path that leads to each
Trace the path a data packet takes across the internet and identify interception points
Explain the shared responsibility model and how cloud misconfiguration causes breaches
Analyze a cascade failure and identify the root cause attack vector
author: Cyber Learn Team
